Test Case Description: Verify client clears tokens even when blacklist storage fails
PreRequisites:
- User is logged in
- Simulate blacklist/cache service failure (Redis down)
Steps to Perform: Click Đăng xuất button in navigation menu
Test Case Expected Result: Client-side logout succeeds even if server blacklist operation fails. Local storage is cleared and user is redirected to login page.

Step Expected Result: Loading indicator appears, server may show error

Steps to Perform: Verify client-side logout despite server failure
Step Expected Result:
- Local storage is cleared on client side
- User is redirected to login page
- Warning message may be shown: 'Đã đăng xuất (một số thao tác trên server có thể thất bại)'
- Client does not block logout even if server returns error
- User cannot access protected pages from this client
